2114063230930694302.en_summary: Rewrote the song “DIAMOND IN THE ROUGH” as a message of resilience for those who have been rejected, betrayed, or underestimated, emphasizing standing up, not needing approval, and shining under pressure.
2114063230930694302.zh_summary: 重寫了歌曲“DIAMOND IN THE ROUGH”，作為對那些被拒絕、背叛或低估的人的韌性訊息，強調站起來，不需要認可，並在壓力下閃耀。
2114063230930694302.ko_summary: “DIAMOND IN THE ROUGH” 노래를 다시 썼으며, 거부당하거나 배신당하거나 과소평가된 사람들을 위한 회복력 메시지로, 일어서고, 승인을 필요로 하지 않으며, 압력 아래 빛나는 것을 강조한다.

2114061191123185686.en_summary: Elon doesn't treat his scientists very well. All founders of x.ai have left, many Neuralink scientists have left (Elon put his name as first author of their paper), and many SpaceX engineers are leaving to create their own startups as it's the only game in town.
2114061191123185686.zh_summary: Elon對他的科學家不太好。x.ai的所有創始人都離開了，許多Neuralink科學家也離開了（Elon將自己的名字作為他們論文的第一作者），許多SpaceX工程師正在離開去創建自己的初創公司，因為那是唯一的選擇。
